limits: lexical reuse and future byte prediction only
state interventions identify computational dependence, not world action effects

bootstrap.limitation: five clusters; exploratory internal uncertainty, not independent qualification
bootstrap.pairing: all conditions and all episodes retained together within each sampled publisher
bootstrap.seed_handling: average all three frozen checkpoint seeds per episode before resampling

positive_minus_negative_nll_interaction.limitation: strata differ in source content; this does not isolate semantic identifier storage
